# Models interface There are three areas of the Solidatus platform for working with models: the Model Browser, the Model Viewer, and the Model Overview. Use the links in the table to explore the functionality in each model-related area.
Model BrowserThis is where you can find and open all models you can access or create a new model. You can also perform several useful actions including exporting and importing.
Model ViewerThis is the canvas for building, exploring, and analysing models.
Model OverviewThis is where you can view model information and work with version control features involving revision history and pull requests for forks. You can also access activities, settings, and permissions.
While the Model Viewer is the main canvas for building and exploring a model, lineage and model content can be explored in other areas that have unique analytical and visual capabilities.
AreaDescription
Model OverviewThis provides useful information about a model, including a directory of model entities, version history, settings, and links to the other areas.
Lineage ExplorerThis feature allows the user to extract a subset of entities out of a complex model, so you can analyse lineage in isolation from the clutter of other parts of a model.
Graph ExplorerThe Graph Explorer gives you a visualisation of a model as an animated graph. It displays entities as nodes and transitions, parent-child links, and reference relationships as edges.
